evidence_quotes.quote: SRAM RED AXS E1 complete groupset weight: 2,496 g (48/35T power meter crankset, 10-28T XG-1290 cassette, 160 mm rotors, fluid, two AXS batteries)
Requires SRAM XDR driver body for 10T-start XG-1290 12-speed cassettes, SRAM DUB 28.99 mm bottom bracket, and 12-speed Flattop chain (not compatible with Shimano HG/HG+)
DUB crank arm bolt torque 54 Nm; XDR cassette lockring 40 Nm; DOT 5.1 hydraulic brake fluid; ~60 hr rechargeable AXS derailleur batteries and CR2032 shifter cells

adversarial_checks: Generation check: Distinguished SRAM RED AXS E1 (2024+, 2,496 g, one-finger braking, Bonus Buttons, cut-out HollowPin Flattop chain) from legacy RED AXS D1.
Non-interchangeability check: Explicitly verified XDR freehub, DUB 28.99 mm BB, Flattop chain roller size, and DOT 5.1 brake fluid incompatibilities vs Shimano 12s Di2.
SM-02 check: Verified complete groupset US ($4,450) and KR (6,100,000 KRW) benchmarks under msrp_benchmark_mode with asin: null.
